name: The Coca-Cola Company

corporate_actions.event: Henrique Braun succeeded James Quincey as CEO (Quincey Executive Chairman) - announced Dec-2025
Costa Coffee sale abandoned Jan-2026 after low bids; sale reportedly being explored again Oct-2026

geography.fx_notes: ~60% of revenue outside the US, sizable EM (LatAm, APAC) (S2). Price/mix inflated by hyperinflationary markets (Argentina) in 2023-25 - organic growth overstates real pricing power. Costa (UK) small share of revenue.

organic_growth.note: concentrate sales +7% (2pts ahead of unit case volume +5%)

kpis.name: Unit case volume
kpis.value: +5% Q3-2026 (India, China, Mexico, Brazil); North America flat

kpis.name: IRS transfer-pricing dispute
kpis.value: USD6bn paid 2024; up to ~USD14bn more if 11th Circuit appeal fails; argued Jun-2026, decision pending

company_fcf.definition: Free cash flow (non-GAAP; OCF - capex, excluding fairlife contingent payment)

acquisitions.earnouts: fairlife contingent consideration (very large, ~USD6bn payable 2026 per prior disclosures - not re-verified)
acquisitions.notes: BodyArmor 2021 (USD5.6bn) impaired; Costa 2019 (USD5.1bn) under sale review

management.guidance_record: Strong: met/raised organic guidance; 2026 raised to >=5% (S1)

ownership.related_party: Equity stakes in bottlers (CCEP, FEMSA, HBC etc.) - transactions with equity-method bottlers disclosed

evidence: Concentrate sold to bottler system in 200+ countries (S2)
A.rationale: Highly recurring; bottler concentration not disclosed.

evidence: Unit case volume +5% with price/mix gains (S1)
B.rationale: Iconic brand plus bottler system create durable moat.

C.rationale: Asset-light concentrate model yields superior margins (EBIT ~36% vs staples peers 10-24%).

D.rationale: Moderate volume runway in EM; mature in developed markets.

evidence: BodyArmor impairment; Costa sale attempts failed (S5)

J.rationale: High resilience; FX the main swing factor.

evidence: Large IRS dispute; fairlife contingent consideration remeasurements (S4)

sector_specific.price_volume_note: volume = concentrate sales; 2021-2024 recalled (confidence M); price/mix includes hyperinflation (Argentina) effects
sector_specific.private_label_risk: Low: brand-led category; private-label colas small share (INFERENCE)
sector_specific.top_customer_note: bottlers are main customers; % not disclosed this session
sector_specific.glp1_risk: Moderate for sugared sparkling volumes; zero-sugar mix mitigates (INFERENCE)

gates.notes: G2 B: unresolved IRS transfer-pricing case (USD6bn paid; up to ~USD14bn additional) - open question (not an accounting restatement). G7: Costa UK small.

bull_points: World's leading beverage brand; unit case volume +5% in Q3-26 (S1)
bear_points: Historic organic growth heavily price/mix incl. hyperinflation; developed-market volume flat (S1)
IRS tax case could cost up to ~USD14bn more (S4)
GLP-1 and health trends vs sugared drinks; Costa drag
thesis_breakers: Unit case volume growth below 1% for FY2027
